pergunta: How did Joanna celebrate after sharing her book with her writers group?

focused_selection.text:
Session date: 6:44 pm on 17 April, 2022
[D8:15] Nate: Me too! I love watching them play to simply enjoy the peaceful moments of life. Sometimes I even bring them in the kitchen so they can watch me make food like this!
[D8:16] Joanna: I love your icecream so much! I wish I could make it the way you do!
[D8:17] Nate: Thanks! It's dairy-free and so easy. Wanna get the recipe?
[D8:18] Joanna: Sure! I'm lactose intolerant, so I'll just need the dairy-free recipe! 
[D8:19] Nate: No prob. I made it with coconut milk, vanilla extract, sugar, and a pinch of salt. After chilling it in the fridge, I put it in the ice cream maker and froze it until it was scoopable.
[D8:20] Joanna: Wow, sounds delicious! I'm going to try making it tonight! Thank you for sharing the recipe!
[D8:21] Nate: Hey Joanna, glad I could help. Let me know how it turns out!
[D8:22] Joanna: Got it, Nate. I'll definitely let you know how it turns out. Thanks for sharing the recipe!
Session date: 7:44 pm on 21 April, 2022
[D9:1] Joanna: Hey Nate! Long time no talk! I wanted to tell ya I just joined a writers group. It's unbelievable--such inspirational people who really get my writing. I'm feeling so motivated and supported, it's like I finally belong somewhere!
[D9:2] Nate: Hey Joanna! That's awesome! Having a supportive group around you can really make a difference. What kind of projects are you working on with them?
[D9:3] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! We've made some great progress. I'm working on one with my group called "Finding Home." It's a script about a girl on a journey to find her true home. I find it really rewarding and emotional. What about you? Any upcoming gaming tournaments?
[D9:4] Nate: Hi Joanna! "Finding Home" sounds really special. Must be so meaningful to work on. I've got a gaming tournament next month and I'm feeling good about it. It's gonna be my 4th one!

Session date: 6:12 pm on 14 August, 2022
[D18:7] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Really appreciate your kind words. It's knowing that my writing can make a difference that keeps me going, even on tough days. So glad to have this outlet to share my stories and hopefully have an impact. How about you? Anything new since we last talked?
[D18:8] Nate: Thanks, Joanna! Your words mean a lot. Since we last spoke, I started teaching people how to make this. Sharing my love for dairy-free desserts has been fun and rewarding.
[D18:9] Joanna: Yum, Nate! I love it when you make coconut milk icecream, it's so good!
[D18:10] Nate: I've been really into making this lately - it's creamy, rich, dairy-free and a new recipe! Wanna try it? I can share the recipe with you if you'd like!
[D18:11] Joanna: I'd love to try it! Thanks for sharing your love for dairy-free desserts. I really appreciate it!
[D18:12] Nate: No problem, Joanna! Always happy to share them with you. Sending you the recipe now!
[...]
Session date: 10:57 am on 22 August, 2022
[D19:5] Nate: They're my little buddies, always calm and peaceful. It makes coming home after a long day of gaming better. The tank expansion has made them so happy! How have you been?
[D19:6] Joanna: I'm good! Was super nervous last week when I shared my book with my writers group but got some great feedback. My hard work is paying off, it's such an awesome feeling!
[D19:7] Nate: Wow Jo, you're killing it! Getting this kind of feedback means people are really connecting with your writing. Pretty cool! Did you celebrate?
[...]
[D19:11] Nate: Looks like we both need a break. I'm glad your able to find a way to recharge! It's so incredibly important to take time off!
[D19:12] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! I've learned that taking breaks and looking after myself are important for my inspiration and mental health. It's all about finding balance.
[D19:13] Nate: Yeah, balance is key! It's so cool how taking care of ourselves helps us be more creative and happier. I'm always looking for something new to read. Got any book recommendations? I've got a lot of books to choose from.

Session date: 10:58 am on 9 October, 2022
[D23:20] Joanna: Well, it was amazing, so probably 9 or 10 out of 10! Movies can take us to different places and make us feel lots of emotions. What do you love about watching them?
[D23:21] Nate: Well they take me to new worlds and fill me with emotions. Plus, they're great for chilling out after a day.
[D23:22] Joanna: I agree! They have the power to take us away and make us feel things not normally experienced in life. It's a great escape! Especially when you have a room like this!
[...]
Session date: 8:16 pm on 25 October, 2022
[D25:10] Joanna: I got ideas from everywhere: people I know, stuff I saw, even what I imagined. It's cool to see how an idea takes shape into a person with their own wants, worries, and wishes.
[D25:11] Nate: Wow Joanna, that's so cool! It's amazing how our imaginations can bring ideas to life. Can you tell me more about the character on the left in the photo?
[D25:12] Joanna: Nope! You'll just have to watch the movie and find out for yourself!
[D25:13] Nate: You got it. I was already planning on watching it, but talking to you about it makes me want to watch it even more!
[D25:14] Joanna: Awesome! Well enough about me, what have you been up to?
[D25:15] Nate: I was bored today, so I just took my turtles out for a walk.
[D25:16] Joanna: Sound fun! Did they have a good time?
[D25:17] Nate: Of course! They look tired from all the walking, so they're relaxing in the tank right now.
[D25:18] Joanna: Aww, they're so cute! What do they eat?

Session date: 10:55 am on 24 June, 2022
[D16:7] Joanna: That sounds like a huge success then! Congrats!
[D16:8] Nate: Thanks! On another note, I made vegan ice cream last Friday and shared it with some people in my vegan diet group. It was awesome!
[D16:9] Joanna: Mm, yum! Can you give me the recipe for that? It sounds like it'd be a good recipe!
[...]
[D16:14] Nate: Then I have no doubt they'll love the icecream!
[D16:15] Joanna: Thanks Nate! Your support is greatly appreciated. I'll make sure to keep you updated.
[D16:16] Nate: Can't wait to hear about it. Have a great day! Take care.
Session date: 2:34 pm on 10 July, 2022
[D17:1] Nate: Hey Joanna, check this out! I won my fourth video game tournament on Friday! It was awesome competing and showing off my skills - and the victory was indescribable. I'm really proud that I can make money doing what I love. This one was online!
[D17:2] Joanna: Congrats, Nate! That's awesome! So proud of you. Your hard work really paid off - keep it up! BTW, I took a road trip for research for my next movie while you were winning. Much-needed break and a chance to explore new places and get inspired.
[D17:3] Nate: Thanks, Joanna! Your support means a lot to me. That road trip sounds great! Where did you go? Did you discover any interesting places?
[D17:4] Joanna: Thanks Nate! Appreciate your kind words. I went to Woodhaven, a small town in the Midwest. Got to see some lovely scenery and historic buildings. Checked out the library there, it had a cool old book collection!
[D17:5] Nate: That place looks interesting! Did you find any cool books there?
[D17:6] Joanna: I stumbled upon this super cool book from the 1900s with stories and sketches - so awesome to read about the town and the people living there!

Session date: 7:44 pm on 21 April, 2022
[D9:12] Nate: Yeah, for sure! This trilogy is one of my faves. The world building, battles, and storytelling always blow me away!
[D9:13] Joanna: Wow, that's great to hear! What books do you enjoy? I'm always up for some new book recommendations.
[D9:14] Nate: I love this series. It has adventures, magic, and great characters - it's a must-read!
[...]
Session date: 3:35 pm on 12 May, 2022
[D11:12] Nate: Wow, Jo, that's really cool! It's great to have something that gets those creative juices flowing.
[D11:13] Joanna: I always feel like I could write a whole movie when I'm out there in cool places like that!
[D11:14] Nate: Wow! That's really cool that it inspires you that much! For me I just get deep in thought and think about my life or new recipes.
[D11:15] Joanna: I think about my life too sometimes when I'm out and about, but there was something special about these trails that made me feel like writing a drama.
[D11:16] Nate: Hey, we should go together sometime, don't you think? Maybe I'll start to think of a drama myself and publish my own screenplay.
[D11:17] Joanna: Haha, now that would be something! Sure, you should come down and join me on the trails sometime!
[D11:18] Nate: Sounds like a plan! Thanks for the invite Joanna!
[D11:19] Joanna: Sure thing Nate! See you later!
[D11:20] Nate: See ya!
